{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
dup_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
dup_patients = dup_counts[dup_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients re-tested (sample_seq > 1): {len(dup_patients)}")

# Verify that we need to deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq
# This shows the logic is sound
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

print(f"After deduplication (highest sample_seq kept): {len(df_dedup)}")"}
